_about: v15.2 sea song (work/xvsea, notes/sea-song/AS-BUILT.md): the example "In the Hall of the Mountain King" (Edvard Grieg, Peer Gynt, 1875; public domain), a melody on one curve for the phase harp; its Listen along prompts and the guide's paragraph. id -> {en, ru, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md (1.12 Слушать вдоль кривой, Звук, Математические события; branch cut «разрез»); the harp as in v152-sound.json («арфа», «линии фазы», «щипок струны», «число оборотов»). Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (V152_HERE). Revised for notes/sea-song/review-*.json (ledger.json): the blurb, the guide paragraph and button, and «Спираль». Round 2 (notes/sea-song/r2/AS-BUILT.md): the guide paragraph's last sentence.

v152sea.example_name.en: In the Hall of the Mountain King
v152sea.example_name.note: app.js EX, the example's name (the Examples menu and button). The standard Russian title of Grieg's piece.
